label: Home Assistant Yellow home automation appliance
description: Home Assistant Yellow is a Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4 based home-automation appliance that runs Home Assistant OS and hosts the whole local automation stack (web UI on 8123, REST/WebSocket API, MQTT broker add-ons). It is wired-only: one Gigabit Ethernet port (PoE+ on the PoE kit variant) and no WiFi, with an on-board Zigbee 3.0 / Thread radio for devices - that radio is not an Ethernet or WiFi interface, so the box is cabled, never associated.
